run_inverse_dynamics: run the inverse dynamics computation for a MuJoCo model using the inverse function with Model and Data objects
compute_discrete_acceleration: compute discrete-time to continuous-time acceleration conversion with the discrete_acc function for Euler and IMPLICITFAST integrators
solve_inverse_constraints: solve inverse constraint forces for a MuJoCo model using the inv_constraint function with Model and Data objects
compute_euler_damping_force: compute Euler damping forces per degree of freedom using the _qfrc_eulerdamp kernel with timestep, damping, and polynomial coefficients
compute_inverse_force: compute inverse generalized force from bias, inertia, passive, and constraint terms using the _qfrc_inverse kernel
